title.zh-TW: 最高 NT$100 免費停車優惠
title.en: Up to NT$100 free parking credit

text.zh-TW: 註冊後最高可享；取自平台分享文案，實際內容與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Available after registration, up to the stated amount. Taken from the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」：本站會複製邀請碼，並開啟 App 下載頁。
steps.en: Select “Sign up”: this site copies the invite code and opens the app download page.

steps.zh-TW: 下載並開啟 App，完成免費註冊。
steps.en: Download and open the app, then complete the free registration.

steps.zh-TW: 在註冊畫面貼上邀請碼 DXQ2z。
steps.en: Paste the invite code DXQ2z on the registration screen.

intro.zh-TW: 停車資訊 App。下載後免費註冊，並輸入好友邀請碼。
intro.en: A parking information app. Download it, register for free and enter the friend invite code.

description.zh-TW:
停車大聲公（PKLOT）是提供停車資訊的 App，可免費註冊。本站的連結不含邀請碼：點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會複製邀請碼 DXQ2z，並開啟 App 下載頁。

下載並開啟 App 後，在註冊畫面貼上邀請碼，也可手動輸入；註冊後最高 NT$100 的免費停車優惠取自平台分享文案，實際內容與期限以官方公告為準。
description.en:
PKLOT is a parking information app, and registration is free. The link on this page does not carry the invite code: selecting “Sign up” copies code DXQ2z and opens the app download page.

After downloading and opening the app, paste the code on the registration screen, or type it in by hand. The free parking credit of up to NT$100 after registration comes from the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 此連結不含邀請碼，必須在註冊時手動輸入。連結是短網址（go.pklot.app），會轉址到 App 下載頁。
notes.en: This link does not carry the invite code, so you must enter it during registration. The link is a short URL (go.pklot.app) that redirects to the app download page.
